5 تَوَسَّمْتُ فِيهِ الخَبْرَ
i. q. تَفَرَّسْتُهُ; (S;) [I discovered, or perceived, in him good, or goodness, by right opinion formed from its outward signs;] originally, I knew its real existence in him by its outward sign. (MF.) See also Har, pp. 30, 46, 76. ―
-b2- تَوَسَّمَ He examined deliberately in order to know the real state or character of a thing by the external sign thereof. (Bd, xv. 75.) ―
-b3- He perceived a thing by forming a correct opinion from its outward signs. (TK.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
